[P2] Require coverage for a missing answers object

Every parsed-response fixture supplies an `answers` object; the wrong-shape tests only change entries within it. Deleting this guard therefore leaves the assertions unchanged, while replies such as `{}` or `{ answers: null }` would produce `StepError` instead of `DeciderInvalidResponseError`. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Return to the validation/test design and require the public operations to reject missing, null, and non-object answer envelopes with the advertised error.
